Added 2026-10-20 by recovery of the June 2026 folding share. The VH/VL pairing originates in this patent's own similar_antibody_seq_ids as already curated in POISK v1.3; the June extraction materialised it into a row with sequences. Affinity, epitope and discovery fields were deliberately not carried over and are empty. antibody_identifier is derived from the patent and SEQ IDs: the source file's antibody name was found to name the wrong clone in 8 of the patents checked against the patent text.
